description: Ministry of Labour - Notice of repudiation of an award of an Arbitrator (E Only)
reasoning: This gazette content concerns the repudiation of an arbitrator's award under the Industrial Disputes Act (Chapter 131). It is a legal notice regarding the application and effect of a specific piece of legislation, making it a clear example of a Legal/Regulatory Gazette (Type 5). The content does not involve government structure/personnel (Types 1-3) or any of the other specialized categories like Land, Commercial, or Elections.
